post.description: Streams the answer as `text/event-stream`. Events, in order: `ready` (StreamReadyEvent) → `plan` (StreamPlanEvent, when Jack uses his tools: documents, images, the AI Crews) → `model` (StreamModelEvent) → `delta` (StreamDeltaEvent, repeated) → `done` or `error` (StreamEndEvent). Closing the connection does not stop the answer: it is written and saved anyway. To stop, call `POST /api/chats/{id}/stop`; it is charged only if text had arrived. Not enough credits, a Pro model on Free and provider failures arrive as an `error` event with the saved message.
